name: Pull-up
summary: Hang from a bar with palms facing away and pull your chest up to it. The main bodyweight pulling exercise for the back.
setup: Grip the bar with palms facing away, hands a little wider than your shoulders. Wrap your thumbs around the bar.
Hang with straight arms. Squeeze your glutes and point your toes slightly forward so your body is one firm line, not swinging.

steps.text: Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulders down away from your ears. Your body rises a few centimetres. This starts every rep.
Drive your elbows down toward your back pockets. Lead with your chest toward the bar.
Finish with your chin over the bar and your upper chest close to it. Shoulders stay down, not shrugged into your ears.
Lower under control until your arms are straight, then let your shoulders rise last.

jointCues.cue: Down first, then back. Start each rep with a small shoulder-blade pull before the elbows bend.
jointCues.why: Starting from the shoulder blades brings in the lower traps and lats and keeps the shoulder from being yanked at the bottom.

jointCues.cue: Point down to the floor and pull toward your ribs, slightly in front of your body.
jointCues.why: Elbows that drift far behind the body round the shoulders forward at the top.

jointCues.cue: Think of bending the bar into a U, so your upper arms rotate slightly outward.
jointCues.why: This keeps the ball of the shoulder centered and gives you a stronger lat contraction.

jointCues.cue: Look forward, chin neutral. Do not crane your chin up to reach the bar.
jointCues.why: Reaching with the chin strains the neck and hides a short rep.

jointCues.cue: Ribs down, glutes tight, legs together.
jointCues.why: A rigid body stops swinging and puts the work on the back.

breathing: Breathe in at the bottom while you set your shoulders, breathe out as you pull up, breathe in as you lower.
tempo: Pull in about 1 s, lower in 2 to 3 s

mistakes.fault: Half reps that stop with bent arms
mistakes.fix: Straighten your arms fully at the bottom of each rep.

mistakes.fault: Shrugging the shoulders to the ears at the top
mistakes.fix: Lead with the chest and keep pulling the shoulders down.
Squeeze glutes and legs together. Use a band or slow negatives if you cannot finish the rep strictly.

safety: Make sure the bar is fixed and rated for your weight. Doorway bars should be the screw-in or frame-hook type.

cues.text: Pull your shoulders down away from your ears before the elbows bend
Drive your elbows down toward your back pockets
Bend the bar into a U: upper arms turn slightly out
Chin clears the bar, shoulders stay down
